purpose: Machine-readable capability and evidence-return contract for a cooperating facility executing the R2 metrology qualification stack.

required_capabilities.description: Calibrated broadband reference detector with calibration certificate/report and configuration applicability metadata.
Wavelength-resolved source spectra across the frozen R2 intensity grid and reference/DUT responsivity data on a declared wavelength grid.
Detector/source linearity characterization over the acquisition range used for R2.
Repeated reference-detector sweeps with session/day/sweep hierarchy preserved for empirical covariance estimation and prospective holdout.
Repeated characterized electrical reference steps through the exact SMU/digitizer/cabling/software path with fixed range/filter/aperture and autorange disabled.
Repeated large optical intensity-step transients on the same qualified R2 pixel under the intended acquisition configuration.
Standard monotonic and frozen randomized-order Voc-intensity acquisition on the same qualified pixel after prerequisite gates.

status_semantics.PASS: All evidence required for this gate is present and the frozen gate criteria pass.
status_semantics.FAIL: Required evidence is present but a frozen criterion is violated. The failed result must remain visible.
status_semantics.INCOMPLETE: Material required evidence or provenance is absent. Missing evidence may not be represented as zero uncertainty or PASS.

safety_boundary: Facility optical, electrical, thermal, source-duty, interlock, and instrument-rating rules remain controlling. Randomization or qualification testing never overrides a safety limit.
